sections.Profile:
"Mystic Marvel," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1954, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features a magic and playing cards theme, with the backglass depicting a magician performing tricks. The playfield includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, and a standup target.
